desc: Compute prefix sum arrays $P$ and $C$ for `nums` and `cost` respectively.
Initialize the DP array with infinity, setting $DP[0] = 0$, and prepare a variable to track the overall minimum answer.
Iterate $i$ from 1 to $N$ (representing the number of subarrays), and for each $i$, use a deque to maintain the lower convex hull of lines for CHT.
For each position $j$ from 1 to $N$, add the line corresponding to $l = j-1$ to the CHT structure, query the minimum value at $x = P[j] + k \cdot i$, and update $DP[j]$.
After each $i$ iteration, update the global minimum answer with $DP[N]$ and return the result.
